tweets.text:
.@SECWAR "I witnessed lethality.

I met a junior airman, as the sun was going down, who—when asked what they needed—simply looked at me with a sly smile on her face and said, 'More bombs, sir—and bigger bombs.' We will happily oblige.

I met the Army targeting team who found and sunk the pride and joy of the Iranian Navy. Their fighting position was plastered with images of sunken enemy ships."
